description: Read-only. Read in full any id a pack names (like `pk get`): a work item or area (its pack), a source src_… (the original; for code, where it is and the version read), a note, a rule, a breakpoint, a send-back, or any other object with its neighbours. Ids, not paths.

cwd.description: A folder inside the project. Default: the folder the server was started in.

id.description: An id from a pack or from projectkeeper_options.

port.description: Workbench port. Default: the one in ProjectKeeper's settings (4870).

project.description: Project id (`pk projects` lists them). Default: the project containing cwd.

name: projectkeeper_get
